text: Kalamu #hub — one always-on local server, all projects in a sidebar (SPEC.md 'Hub' section is canonical)
hub.ts countOpenTasks ignores the done-ancestor closure rule, so the sidebar badge disagrees with next and with the new progress rings — reuse core's progress counting
Mod+Shift+3/4/5 are macOS screenshot shortcuts — the hub never sees them, so projects 3–5 aren't reachable by keyboard on a default Mac. Keep as-is, remap, or add a second binding?
Resolved 2026-08-10: retired the Mod+Shift+1…9 chord entirely rather than remap — the ⌘K leader menu now opens project n via ⌘K n with no OS clash; sidebar hint and cheat sheet updated, SPEC amended

Split/merge round-trip loses the boundary space when the caret sits after it ("Parent |Split"): commit-time whitespace normalization trims the before-half's trailing space, so a later Backspace-merge yields "ParentSplit". Exact round-trip would need the split commit to skip trailing-space normalization - core commit/tokens change, needs a decision.

stop.test.ts leaks the machine's real launchd state: hubAgentInstalled() reads the actual LaunchAgents plist, so 4 stopKalamu tests fail on any machine with the hub installed as a login item — inject/stub the plist path in tests #hub #test

release.mjs: detect an already-bumped state after a failed npm publish. Right now the version, commit and tag are all in place but the [Unreleased] section is stamped, so re-running double-bumps; it should notice package.json already matches the last tag and offer publish-only recovery instead
